name: order_changes_the_part
why: ENTRY Z-F3. A shell placed before a hole gives a different part from one placed after. Measured on 27/9/2026 (prova0089 zf3): 100x60x40 box, Ø10 through hole from the top, shell 3 opening the top: hole then shell 56485.7 mm3, shell before the hole 51952.38; ReorderFeature puts it back as it was; moving the hole before the extrusion it sits on answers false and touches nothing.
defect_caught: The move believed done because ReorderFeature answered true, without looking at the tree and the volume; the impossible move taken for good; a tree left broken by a move.

expect.tolerance_why: pi inside: 240000 minus pi x 5^2 x 40
measured by the probe (56485.7): the shell around the hole has no short formula
measured by the probe: the hole made after the shell cuts only the bottom
the same, read from the state

expect.why: put back where it was, the part returns to what it was before
